move: letters yank in tall and thin, snap elastic, tug wide, rip out
how: An orange ground with a yellow 520px blob breathing behind seven uppercase letter spans and a small caption. The blob scales .9 to 1.08 and rotates 25deg with sine.inOut yoyo over the 2s. Letters arrive from scaleY 3.4 / scaleX .35 / yPercent -90 / opacity 0 with power2.in over 0.12s and a 0.05s stagger from 2.5%, then relax to natural shape with elastic.out(1.15, 0.38) over 0.85s. At 55% a second tug stretches every letter to scaleX 1.55 / scaleY .72 with power3.in staggered from the centre, snapping back with elastic.out(1.2, 0.35). At 84% the letters are yanked up as tall thin ribbons (scaleY 3, scaleX .3, yPercent -120, power3.in) and the caption fades, leaving the blob.
adapt: Change the word (split into .ch spans), the ground/blob/ink colours and the caption. Keep the elastic.out parameters and the two-phase stretch; adjust font size for word length.
port: mount(el, shot) renders the .blob, the .word split into .ch spans and .sub; animate(el, shot, D) returns a gsap.timeline with the entry at 0.025D, elastic settle at 0.085D, the tug at 0.55D and the exit at 0.84D, with the blob yoyo as a D/2 tween repeated once. Use el.querySelectorAll('.ch').
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false if built after paint
